item.title: Rob Pelinka to remain in charge of basketball operations for Lakers
item.description: The Lakers began their front office transformation under Mark Walter with the hiring of Lon Rosen, replacing Tim Harris as President of Business Operations. item.title: Magic storm back in second half, hand Lakers second straight defeat
item.description: For the first time this season, the Lakers lost when leading after three quarters, falling to the Magic at home on Tuesday, 110-109.
